description: Unidentified miscreants broke into a locked residential flat in South Delhi and made off with gold ornaments and digital devices.
A commuter on a crowded local train in Mumbai reported the theft of a leather handbag containing cash, identity cards, and a smartphone.
Two individuals riding a motorcycle snatched a gold chain from a pedestrian walking along a busy commercial street in Bengaluru.
Unknown persons stole a parked motorcycle from outside a commercial complex located in the central business district of Pune.
Shop staff in a crowded clothing store in Jaipur discovered that the cash drawer was forced open and daily collections were missing.
A visiting tourist at a heritage site in Agra reported the theft of a backpack containing expensive camera equipment and travel documents.
Miscreants scaled the boundary wall of a warehouse on the outskirts of Hyderabad and stole several cartons of electronic goods.
An elderly citizen waiting at a bus stop in Kolkata was targeted by a pickpocket who managed to extract a wallet from the victim's pocket.
Copper wiring and electrical fixtures were reported stolen from an under-construction apartment complex in Ahmedabad.
A delivery executive left his bicycle unlocked outside a grocery store in Chennai, and it was stolen within minutes.
Thieves broke the window of a parked car in a residential colony in Lucknow and stole a laptop bag kept on the back seat.
A resident of a housing society in Gurugram reported the theft of potted plants and decorative brass items kept outside the front door.
Unidentified suspects posing as courier service personnel entered an office in Noida and stole a mobile phone from the reception desk.
A bicycle parked inside the premises of an educational institution in Chandigarh went missing during morning lecture hours.
The lock of a small neighborhood provision store in Patna was broken overnight, and stock items along with the cash box were stolen.
A passenger traveling in an express train reported the theft of a trolley suitcase kept near the berth after the train crossed a junction.
Miscreants stole several meters of high-tension overhead copper cables in an industrial area on the outskirts of Bhopal.
A mobile phone was snatched from the hands of a commuter standing near the door of a moving metro train in Kochi.
Acting on a tip-off, Mumbai Anti-Narcotics Cell intercepted a vehicle near Mahim and recovered two kilograms of mephedrone, arresting the driver under the NDPS Act.
Bangalore City Crime Branch raided a rented apartment in Koramangala, seizing 500 grams of MDMA pills and arresting two foreign nationals operating a local distribution network.
During routine vehicle checking at a Delhi traffic checkpoint, police personnel recovered one kilogram of heroin concealed inside the spare tire of a commercial truck.
Hyderabad Prohibition and Excise department conducted a raid on a warehouse in Bowenpally, confiscating 100 kilograms of ganja intended for interstate trafficking.
Chennai City Police arrested a local peddler near the railway station after finding 50 grams of brown sugar and digital weighing scales in his possession.
Kolkata Police STF intercepted a courier parcel at a local hub originating from the northeast, seizing 10,000 Yaba tablets hidden within decorative wooden artifacts.
Pune Anti-Narcotics Cell raided a rooftop party in Koregaon Park, detaining several individuals and seizing small quantities of cocaine and charas for recreational use.
Ahmedabad Crime Branch arrested a chemist shop owner for illegally selling prescription psychotropic substances without maintaining mandatory medical records.
Jaipur Police intercepted a bus entering the city outskirts and apprehended a passenger carrying three kilograms of opium wrapped in traditional fabric bundles.
Goa Anti-Narcotics Cell conducted a beachside raid in Anjuna, arresting a local vendor found in possession of processed LSD blots and synthetic cannabis.
The complainant reported receiving anonymous calls demanding five lakh rupees under threat of releasing morphed photographs to their employer in Mumbai.
A local businessman in Delhi was coerced into paying regular protection money to an organized extortion racket after his shop was vandalized.
Cyber cell registered a case where the victim was blackmailed through video recordings obtained via a malicious mobile application downloaded in Bangalore.
The accused intercepted a delivery truck in Jaipur and forced the driver to transfer funds digitally to avoid physical harm.
An owner of a coaching institute in Patna received extortion letters containing live cartridges, demanding a heavy monthly levy for unhindered operations.
Two individuals were arrested in Chennai for blackmailing a real estate developer using fabricated documents regarding land ownership disputes.
The victim was lured through a social media platform and subsequently held captive in an apartment in Hyderabad while extortionists demanded ransom from relatives.
A hotel manager in Kolkata lodged a complaint stating that self-proclaimed union leaders demanded extortion payments under the threat of shutting down business.

The complainant reported a fraudulent online investment scheme where the accused promised high returns on cryptocurrency trading through a mobile application, resulting in a loss of fifteen lakh rupees.

An unidentified caller posing as a bank manager duped the elderly victim into sharing their debit card pin and one-time password, subsequently unauthorized withdrawals were made from the savings account.
The accused posted a fake advertisement on a classifieds portal for selling a second-hand motor vehicle and collected an advance booking amount from the buyer before disconnecting all communication.
A fake job placement agency in Connaught Place collected registration and interview fees from multiple job seekers under the pretext of securing employment abroad, then closed their office.

The victim received an SMS containing a malicious link regarding electricity bill payment dues; after clicking the link and entering credentials, funds were siphoned off via multiple UPI transactions.
An organized syndicate manufactured and distributed counterfeit branded consumer goods in wholesale markets, causing massive financial losses to the original manufacturing corporation.
The accused forged property ownership documents and sold a residential plot in a prime locality to the unsuspecting buyer by impersonating the actual landowner.
A fraudulent matrimonial profile was created by the accused to build a romantic relationship with the victim, eventually extracting funds under the guise of medical emergencies.
The merchant fell victim to a QR code scam where a customer sent a morphed payment success notification screenshot instead of actual money for high-value electronic goods.
Employees of a call center made international phone calls defrauding foreign nationals by posing as tax authority representatives and demanding immediate settlement fines through gift cards.
The cooperative society's accountant embezzled funds from member accounts over two years by manipulating ledger entries and generating fake audit reports.
A fake loan approval portal charged processing fees and insurance amounts from applicants but failed to disburse any loan amounts as promised in the advertisement.
The victim was added to a suspicious WhatsApp trading group where manipulated stock market tips were shared, leading to heavy investments in shell company shares orchestrated by the fraudsters.

An insurance agent collected premium renewal amounts in cash from elderly policyholders for years but never deposited the money into the actual insurance company accounts, issuing forged receipts instead.
The e-commerce seller received a fake return request where the buyer replaced a high-end smartphone with a dummy device and initiated a courier return to claim a full refund.
A fraudulent tour and travel agency booked dummy hotel rooms and flight tickets for a family vacation package, leaving the travelers stranded at the airport with invalid reservations.
The complainant in Mumbai reported losing 4.5 lakh rupees after downloading a remote access application upon instructions from a fake customer support representative.
A Bengaluru-based IT professional fell victim to a part-time job scam on Telegram, transferring funds across multiple UPI handles for purported task completions with false high returns.
Cyber police in Hyderabad registered an FIR regarding unauthorized withdrawals from a senior citizen's bank account following receipt of a fraudulent KYC expiration text message.
The Chennai cyber cell received a complaint about morphed images of a college student being circulated on Instagram along with defamatory text and extortion demands.
A Pune resident lost life savings to an investment fraud involving a fraudulent mobile trading application that displayed fake profits before locking out withdrawal requests.
Kolkata police investigated a business email compromise incident where a local trading firm transferred 28 lakh rupees to a hacker-controlled account after intercepted invoice communication.
An Ahmedabad-based homemaker was duped of 60,000 rupees through a lottery scam promising a luxury car win upon payment of advance processing and clearance fees.
Delhi Police cyber crime unit arrested operators of a fake call center that targeted foreign nationals by offering technical support services and demanding payment via gift cards.
The Jaipur cyber wing registered a case after a victim's credit card was maxed out following an online transaction on a phishing replica of a popular utility bill payment portal.
A Chandigarh university professor reported a case of identity theft wherein an unknown perpetrator created a fake social media profile to solicit financial aid from academic colleagues.
Lucknow police filed a cyber extortion case after a local businessman received WhatsApp video calls from an unknown number displaying compromising recorded footage.
A Kochi resident lost 1.2 lakh rupees when an online marketplace buyer sent a malicious QR code under the guise of transferring payment for a second-hand bicycle.
An investigation was launched in Mumbai after a tip-off led authorities to a beauty parlor where two minor girls from Assam were found locked in the back room and coerced into commercial sex work.
New Delhi railway station security intercepted an individual attempting to transport three young boys from rural Bihar under false promises of employment in garment factories.
Bangalore police raided a purported placement agency operating in a residential suburb, rescuing five women whose passports were confiscated to force unpaid domestic servitude.
Hyderabad local authorities rescued four interstate migrant workers from a brick kiln where the employer withheld their wages and restricted their movement through physical threats.
Chennai anti-human trafficking unit detained two suspects operating a fraudulent modeling ring that lured aspiring actors from tier-two cities into forced digital pornography networks.
Kolkata enforcement personnel intercepted a vehicle near the border carrying four young adults who were being trafficked across state lines on fraudulent transit documents for bonded labor.
Intercepted a commercial vehicle at the city toll plaza, recovering twenty kilograms of smuggled gold bullion concealed within modified fuel tanks.
Apprehended two individuals near the railway station carrying multiple foreign-origin electronic gadgets and high-end smartphones without customs duty receipts.
Raided a residential warehouse in the port district, seizing a large cache of contraband red sandalwood logs intended for illegal maritime export.
Dismantled an interstate syndicate at a bus depot by confiscating several packets of exotic wildlife species and rare turtle shells hidden in luggage.
Seized a substantial quantity of banned foreign currency and undeclared precious gemstones from a passenger arriving on an international flight.
Stopped a speeding delivery van on the national highway bypass, discovering thousands of cartons of smuggled foreign cigarettes stashed under grocery bags.
Recovered multiple vials of restricted pharmaceutical stimulants and performance-enhancing hormones during a surprise check at a local courier hub.
Confiscated vintage bronze artifacts and antique idols from a clandestine storage unit following a tip-off about an upcoming illicit export deal.
The complainant reported that a verbal dispute over parking space allocation escalated when the accused physically assaulted him with a wooden stick in South Delhi.
An altercation outside a local marketplace in Mumbai resulted in the accused slapping and shoving the vendor after a disagreement regarding vegetable prices.
The victim filed an FIR stating that two unknown individuals waylaid him near a desolate alleyway in Bangalore and struck him repeatedly with iron rods.
During a late-night noise complaint dispute in a residential apartment complex in Kolkata, the accused lunged at the resident and caused minor lacerations.
A road rage incident along a busy arterial road in Chennai led to the accused alighting from his vehicle and physically assaulting a motorcyclist over a minor scratch.
The local tea stall owner in Hyderabad was assaulted by an aggrieved customer following a heated argument over unpaid bills and service delays.
Police registered a case after a security guard was beaten up by a group of youths attempting to forcefully enter a gated community in Pune without authorization.
An argument at a neighborhood construction site in Ahmedabad turned violent when a supervisor was struck by a laborer wielding a heavy wrench.
The complainant stated that she was physically manhandled and threatened by her neighbor during a boundary wall dispute in a Jaipur housing colony.
A brawl broke out inside a crowded local train compartment in Mumbai, resulting in one commuter sustaining facial injuries from punches thrown by a co-passenger.
The management of a departmental store in Chandigarh reported that an unruly customer assaulted the cashier following a point-of-sale payment system failure.
An agrarian dispute in a rural outpost near Lucknow escalated when the accused party attacked the complainant with farming implements, causing severe bruises.
Patrolling officers intervened in a street fight in Bhopal where the accused was physically assaulting a pedestrian over a suspected theft allegation.
The victim alleged that her estranged relative barged into her workplace in Patna and physically assaulted her in front of colleagues following a property disagreement.

Case ID MP-2023-101: The complainant reported that their adult son left for a routine bank errand in Connaught Place, New Delhi, and failed to return by evening, with his mobile phone switched off since afternoon.
Case ID MP-2023-102: A local school administration in Andheri West, Mumbai, filed a missing report after an eighth-grade student did not board the designated school bus after dismissal hours.

Case ID MP-2023-103: The spouse of a software professional registered a complaint stating the individual went for an evening walk near Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad, and did not come back home or respond to calls.
Case ID MP-2023-104: Elderly care facility management in Salt Lake, Kolkata, reported that a 78-year-old resident with early-stage dementia wandered away from the premises during morning hours.

Case ID MP-2023-105: Factory supervisors in Peenya, Bengaluru, lodged a missing person report for a migrant daily wage worker who left the worksite during lunch break and failed to report back for the second shift.
Case ID MP-2023-106: The family of a college student studying in Sector 17, Chandigarh, reported them missing after they did not return to the hostel following their end-semester examinations.

Case ID MP-2023-107: A retail store manager in Alwarpet, Chennai, filed a police complaint after a newly hired cashier left the cash counter unattended and departed without settling accounts or notifying colleagues.

Case ID MP-2023-108: Relatives visiting from another state reported that their teenage niece went missing from a crowded railway station platform in Pune while waiting for an outbound connecting train.

The victim was found deceased with multiple stab wounds inside a locked apartment in South Delhi after neighbors reported a foul smell, and preliminary investigation points to a financial dispute with a business associate.
A late-night altercation outside a local dhaba in Mumbai escalated when the accused struck the victim on the head with a heavy iron rod following a heated argument over unpaid bills.

The local police registered a murder case after an elderly couple was found strangled in their independent house in Bengaluru, with signs of forced entry and missing household valuables indicating a robbery gone wrong.

An unidentified body bearing severe blunt force trauma was recovered from the banks of the Hooghly River in Kolkata, and forensic teams are currently analyzing fingerprints to establish identity and trace suspects.

A property dispute among siblings in a residential locality of Lucknow turned fatal when the younger brother allegedly fired a country-made pistol at the elder sibling during a family panchayat meeting.

The body of a local cab driver was discovered in the outskirts of Hyderabad with his throat slit, and the vehicle missing, prompting highway patrols to track the stolen car using automated number plate recognition.
Two helmeted individuals on a motorcycle intercepted a merchant in Karol Bagh, Delhi, forcibly snatching a bag containing four lakh rupees in cash before fleeing.
An armed intruder entered a residential apartment in Andheri West, Mumbai, threatening the domestic help with a blade and escaping with gold jewelry and a laptop.
Three unidentified persons posing as courier delivery agents forced their way into a senior citizen's home in Alipore, Kolkata, looting valuables at knifepoint.
A late-night highway robbery occurred near Electronic City, Bengaluru, where a cab was waylaid by miscreants who looted the passengers of their mobile phones and wallets.
A lone miscreant snatched a gold chain from a pedestrian near Anna Salai, Chennai, during peak evening traffic and escaped into a nearby crowded alleyway.
A jewelry store in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad, reported an armed daylight robbery where two masked men threatened the store attendant and emptied the display counter.
Miscreants aboard a moving auto-rickshaw snatched a handbag from a woman traveling on a separate two-wheeler along Ashram Chowk, New Delhi, causing minor injuries.
A security guard at an ATM kiosk in Salt Lake, Kolkata, was assaulted with an iron rod by a gang attempting to break open the cash chest during the early hours.
Three youths on a scooter intercepted a delivery executive in Koramangala, Bengaluru, and robbed him of his smartphone and daily collection cash under threat of assault.
A shopkeeper in CG Road, Ahmedabad, was robbed at gunpoint by two men who barged into the establishment shortly before closing time and emptied the cash register.
A late-night pedestrian returning from a factory shift in Pimpri, Pune, was cornered by three men who relieved him of his watch, silver ring, and wallet.
Miscreants broke the window of a parked car in Sector 17, Chandigarh, and stole a briefcase containing official documents, a laptop, and cash.
The complainant reported a missing pet dog of a foreign breed from a residential society parking lot in South Delhi.
A local vendor filed a complaint regarding a damaged weighing scale after a dispute over vegetable prices in a Pune market.
The station received an anonymous tip concerning an abandoned old bicycle blocking a narrow lane in a residential area of Jaipur.
Residents of an apartment complex in Bengaluru lodged a nuisance complaint over a stray dog pack creating a disturbance at night.
A civic worker reported a missing manhole cover on a main arterial road in Chennai, prompting a temporary barricade setup.
The management of a Kolkata heritage building filed a report regarding a fallen tree branch that damaged the perimeter wall.
A commuter submitted a lost property application for an umbrella left behind on a local suburban train in Mumbai.
Shopkeepers in a commercial market of Hyderabad reported a temporary power outage caused by a short circuit in a transformer box.
The security guard of a closed industrial unit in Ahmedabad notified police about a stray cow wandering into the premises.
A resident in Lucknow registered a complaint regarding a persistent water leakage from the overhead municipal pipeline near their gate.
Investigation into a suspected narcotics distribution ring operating across multiple districts, involving repeated courier movements and unexplained cash flows.
Follow-up probe into a suspected supply chain moving contraband through transport hubs, flagged after informant tips regarding late-night vehicle movements.
Cross-border smuggling investigation involving goods routed through intermediary warehouses and irregular manifest documentation.
Customs referral regarding suspected undervaluation and diversion of consignments through a network of trading firms.
Financial fraud investigation into a suspected hawala-style layering scheme using multiple shell trading accounts to obscure the origin of funds.
Bank-flagged suspicious transaction pattern investigation involving structuring of deposits just under reporting thresholds across several accounts.
Investigation into a suspected online phishing/mule-account operation used to route defrauded funds through intermediary accounts before withdrawal.
Preliminary inquiry into suspected recruitment and transport of individuals under false employment promises, based on informant intelligence.
Extortion complaint investigation involving repeated threatening contact with a local business owner, with calls traced to multiple intermediary numbers.
Follow-up case examining a pattern of intimidation calls linked to a local protection-racket allegation near a wholesale market.
Multi-agency intelligence coordination case consolidating surveillance leads on a suspected organized network operating out of a metropolitan transport hub.
Joint task force case file tracking suspected coordination between financial intermediaries and known persons of interest from prior narcotics cases.
